productFit.variant: Leofoto's EU dealer (leofoto.net, NIMAX) lists the set as 'LS-284C Ranger + Ballhead LH-30 + 2-segment centre column DC-282C' (code without the X suffix of the US kit); same 4-section columnless carbon legs, LH-30 head and add-on column. No EU listing of the X-coded kit was found.

productFit.name: Leofoto LS-224CX Ranger Carbon Fiber Tripod with LH-25 Ball Head

productFit.name: JOBY GorillaPod 3K Kit
productFit.reason: Sold in the Benelux under the same name (Cameranu lists 'Joby GorillaPod 3K Kit Zwart'); Dutch site avondfotografie.nl reviewed the 3K Kit.

localFacts.fact: KLM allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm including handles and wheels: by length the Peak Design (39 cm), LS-224CX (47 cm) and AP-10 (54 cm) fit; the LS-284CX with the head on (about 56 cm) does not.
Het Rijksmuseum verwijst voor fotograferen naar zijn Algemene Voorwaarden, met als voorbeeld: geen statieven en geen extra belichting.
Rijksmuseum Boerhaave in Leiden: fotograferen en filmen mag, maar zonder flits en zonder statief.
Het KNMI noemt windkracht 6 'krachtig', 39-49 km/u, met als uitwerking: 'paraplu's met moeite vast te houden'.
Dutch terms: statiefkop, balhoofd, snelkoppelplaat, middenkolom; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Dutch photographers are unsure whether a tripod is allowed in hand baggage.
localPainPoints.fix: Check the airline's size rule: the Peak Design, LS-224CX and AP-10 fit KLM's 55 cm by length; advice in forums conflicts, so check with the airline before you fly.

localPainPoints.pain: A GorillaPod 3K head sagged with a Nikon Z body and a heavy 24-70.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the GorillaPod for the Zf with the 40mm SE (880 g); put the 24-70mm on a full tripod (English post).

localPainPoints.pain: With the centre column fully up the tripod may not stay still in wind.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the column down or pick the columnless AP-10 or LS-284CX.
